selection: 24 easy2–6, all12 middle8–14 available without frozen keys,24 hard18–20. Balance stories, then distinct puzzle structures, then geometry; id breaks ties. No frozen key (including chainReaction).

traces.note: Two exact first-campaign streams per profile; both planner styles retained, with the style winning the existing full rating marked separately. These samples do not replace full ratings. No early truncation of retries: retry memory is the study outcome.

classification.note: Classify every pre-tap state, including post-error states, with a shared physical-state cache per board. Unknown never means loss. A pure peek is an information-only no-op, not the hypothetical taking of its tile. Report requested losing-option counts and genuine win/lose forks separately. Depth is bounded longest survival after a proven losing action, not exact proof lookahead depth.

ladder.note: Spare1 is built; spare2 changes only the proven minimum-plus-spare clock, preserving the entire puzzle. Recompute forced pressure rather than copying its claim. All actual ways, hidden dig counts and readability failures retained; no board built for a slot.
